history.value: Training-seed sd at run level (one-turn cell gauntlet, end-HP) is about 0.65-0.7 HP pooled over 14 twin groups (review 2026-11-06, two skeptics alike), from about 0 for the 10-29 product recipe's twins to about 1.2 for data-size and burst recipes; the earlier 0.4 HP came from 3 + 2 nets sharing round 0. So a single-seed pair's true se is about 1.1 HP, twice the 0.5 a 500-sequence read prints, a 2-3 se lead from one seed flips in other seeds roughly 13-36% of the time, and a recipe question needs seeds, not sequences (beyond 500 sequences the se falls only about 12%). For two fixed players sequence se are sound (leads at 2-3 se replicated on the other book in 63 of 65 pairs). On the headline setting deck noise is larger: about 0.035 clears se per 250-sequence pair. To be reproduced by the ledger script (backlog experiment-ledger).
